newsitem.title: ITALY: U.N. food aid chief to visit North Korea in March.
newsitem.headline: U.N. food aid chief to visit North Korea in March.

text.p: The executive director of the U.N. World Food Programme, Catherine Bertini, said on Tuesday she would visit North Korea next month to highlight the east Asian country's desperate food situation.
A statement by the Rome-based agency said Bertini's four-day visit to North Korea would begin on March 15.
It said Bertini hoped to draw attention to the food needs of the communist country, where floods have damaged crops and stocks have dwindled to dangerously low levels.

"I think it's critical to know there are 24 million people in this country and that every one of them has over the last few years received less and less food," she was quoted as saying in the statement.
"If this trend continues, and in fact it looks like it may get worse, then we'll see potentially mass starvation and famine in North Korea," she said.
The WFP, which is the United Nations' emergency food aid provider, appealed to the international community two weeks ago for $41.6 million in aid for North Korea.
